title: Image and file URLs from the Notion API stop working about an hour after they are fetched
symptoms: AccessDenied: Request has expired when opening a stored Notion image URL
Static site built from Notion shows broken images the next day
file.expiry_time is about one hour after the request time
cause: Files uploaded into Notion come back as signed links that are valid for one hour, with the cutoff in expiry_time. Only external files keep a permanent URL.
fix: Download and rehost Notion-hosted files at build or sync time, or fetch the block again when expiry_time has passed. Never store the signed URL.
affected: Notion REST API, Notion-hosted files (type file), as of 2026-10
